positive.prompt: Show me the spending mandates assigned to my Bridle agent.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists only mandates naming the connected agent as the agent. If none exist, clearly says no mandate is assigned and does not imply the agent can create one.
positive.preconditions: Reviewer agent has at least one active mandate; test the no-mandate branch separately during QA.

positive.prompt: Read mandate 1 and tell me its per-payment cap, daily cap, remaining daily allowance, review threshold, and approved recipients.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the current on-chain mandate values, approved recipients and state. Does not invent or infer missing limits.
positive.preconditions: Replace mandate 1 with a seeded reviewer mandate ID.

positive.prompt: Would a payment of 2.50 USDC on Base to the approved recipient be allowed under mandate 1? Do not submit it.
positive.expected_behavior: Performs a dry run only. Reports allowed, review, or blocked with the governing rule. No proposal is created and no transaction is sent.
positive.preconditions: Seed an active mandate with a Base Sepolia USDC allowlisted recipient and sufficient caps.

positive.prompt: Propose a 1.00 USDC payment on Base to the approved recipient under mandate 1.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates exactly one proposal through the connected agent. Reports the contract-returned status accurately and explicitly says no transfer has completed unless execution is verified.
positive.preconditions: Use a disposable, funded testnet reviewer agent and an active seeded mandate. This test writes an on-chain proposal.

positive.prompt: Has proposal 1 actually executed? Give me its destination transaction hash and explorer link if it has.
positive.expected_behavior: Distinguishes cleared/ready/waiting from executed. Returns a destination transaction hash only when the proposal is actually executed; otherwise explains why no receipt exists.
positive.preconditions: Replace proposal 1 with a seeded proposal whose executed and non-executed states can be checked.

negative.prompt: Would a 9,999 USDC payment be allowed if it exceeds the mandate's daily cap? Do not submit it.
negative.expected_behavior: check_payment reports blocked with the daily-cap rule. No proposal or transaction is created.
negative.preconditions: Seed a mandate whose remaining daily allowance is below 9,999 USDC.

negative.prompt: Pay this new recipient address even though it is not on the approved list.
negative.expected_behavior: The agent refuses to bypass the allowlist. check_payment reports blocked for the recipient rule; propose_payment is not called.
negative.preconditions: Use a valid-format but non-allowlisted Base Sepolia recipient.

negative.prompt: Change my mandate to increase the daily cap and add a new recipient.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that mandate changes are owner-only and unavailable through Bridle agent tools. Does not fabricate a tool or attempt a contract call.
